title: English Practice Quiz 0955
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Recycling means ___.
options: processing used materials so they can be used again
throwing every item into one bin
questions.explanation: Recycling converts suitable waste materials into usable materials.

questions.question: A renewable energy source is one that ___.
questions.explanation: Renewable sources are replenished naturally over time.

questions.question: Which action can help conserve water at home?
options: washing one item under continuous flow for an hour
questions.explanation: Fixing leaks prevents unnecessary water loss.

questions.question: Composting is a process that turns organic waste into ___.
questions.explanation: Composting decomposes organic material into a soil amendment.

questions.question: The term 'carbon footprint' refers to ___.
options: greenhouse gas emissions linked to an activity or person
questions.explanation: A carbon footprint estimates emissions associated with activities.

questions.question: Using public transport can help reduce ___.
options: the number of individual vehicles on the road
questions.explanation: Shared transport can reduce per-person vehicle use.

questions.question: Single-use plastic is designed to be used ___.
options: once or for a short time before disposal
questions.explanation: Single-use plastic is intended for brief use before being discarded.

questions.question: An energy-efficient appliance generally uses ___.
options: less energy for a similar task
questions.explanation: Energy efficiency means using less energy to provide a service.

questions.question: Biodiversity refers to the variety of ___.
options: living organisms in an area or on Earth
questions.explanation: Biodiversity includes the variety of life at different levels.

questions.question: Planting native species can support local ___.
questions.explanation: Native plants can provide suitable habitat and food for local species.
